stories.title: Australian authorities investigate Flydubai co-pilot's links to country
stories.summary: Australian state police and the security agency are probing the Flydubai co-pilot who, the UAE prosecutor general said, attacked the pilot with a crash axe on a flight toward Israel, plunging the plane 17,000ft before it landed safely in Australia.

stories.title: DeepSeek and Huawei open-source TileLang to challenge Nvidia's CUDA
stories.summary: DeepSeek, with Huawei's backing, open-sourced TileLang, programming infrastructure for Huawei's Ascend chips positioned as an alternative to Nvidia's CUDA. The move aims to reduce China's reliance on US AI hardware, with DeepSeek planning to install about 160,000 Ascend accelerators.

stories.title: Tencent-backed AI chipmaker Enflame jumps 179% in Shanghai debut
stories.summary: Shares of Chinese AI chipmaker Enflame surged 179% in its Shanghai market debut, valuing the company at roughly $25 billion. The listing highlights investor demand for domestic AI chipmakers amid US export restrictions.

stories.title: Browns 27, Steelers 24 | Andre Szmyt hits game-winning 56-yard field goal
stories.summary: Kicker Andre Szmyt nailed a 56-yard field goal with 10 seconds left to give the Browns a 27-24 win over the Steelers, their third straight victory to improve to 3-1. Grant Delpit intercepted Aaron Rodgers to seal the result.

stories.title: How Browns' offensive line put together its best game against Steelers
stories.summary: With veteran center Elgton Jenkins sidelined by a concussion, Luke Wypler and the Browns' revamped offensive line allowed just eight pressures and helped the run game top four yards per carry in a 27-24 win over Pittsburgh — arguably the line's best performance of the season.

stories.title: Julian Sayin, Jeremiah Smith lead No. 5 Ohio State past No. 14 Iowa, 31-14
stories.summary: Julian Sayin threw for 324 yards and three touchdowns, two to Jeremiah Smith, who set Ohio State career records for receptions, receiving yards and touchdowns in the 31-14 road win at Kinnick Stadium. Ohio State improved to 4-1.

stories.title: Three takeaways from Ohio State's 31-14 win at Iowa
stories.summary: Ohio State's defense limited Iowa to 238 yards and five third-down conversions in its first win over a ranked opponent since November. Jeremiah Smith broke multiple school receiving records, but nine costly penalties remain a concern ahead of hosting Maryland.

stories.title: Verstappen wins rain-hit Bahrain GP in Malaysia over Antonelli
stories.summary: Max Verstappen claimed his and Red Bull's first win of the 2026 season at the rain-delayed Bahrain GP in Malaysia, beating Mercedes' Kimi Antonelli by 2.3s. George Russell retired late while running second, a blow to his title hopes.

stories.title: Who is Patrick Havas, alleged attacker at Dr. Amy Acton campaign event
stories.summary: Columbus outlets are reporting on Patrick Havas, the man alleged to have attacked someone at a campaign event for Dr. Amy Acton. The incident has drawn police attention as Acton campaigns in the region.

stories.title: Columbus weather: Storms arrive this evening
stories.summary: Storm Team 4 forecasts severe storms arriving in the Columbus area this evening, triggering a weather alert for the region. Residents are advised to monitor conditions through the evening.

stories.title: Worthington looks ahead in deer culling program
stories.summary: The Columbus-area suburb of Worthington is reviewing next steps in its deer culling program, a recurring effort to manage the local deer population. Officials are weighing how to continue the initiative.
